answer: One enforceable rule: threshold the attestation graph's conductance to flag dense mutual-voting cliques. A single reused nonce reveals every sibling at once. Because it works by raising the marginal cost per fabricated identity to roughly a full epoch of compute, cluster rewards are paid once, not per address. The hollow of work and the pigment of evidence must both recur for the same identity, and a willow to an external peer is the only path that releases the bond.
